visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a shot of the MUJI logo. A woman with light brown hair, wearing a white puffy jacket, stands in a brightly lit MUJI retail store. She holds a small package and places it into a grey plastic shopping basket. (2) A hand holds a brown MUJI paper shopping bag in front of a MUJI storefront with people walking in the background. The lighting is warm and bright. (3) The woman, now with pinkish-red hair, stands in front of a shelf filled with white items. She holds a grey shopping basket and smiles at the camera. (4) A close-up shows a box of 'Dried Pineapple with Chocolate'. A hand moves the box slightly. (5) The woman, wearing a black turtleneck and a white fur vest, holds a square piece of chocolate covered in dried pineapple chunks toward the camera in a kitchen setting. She takes a bite and gives a thumbs-up. (6) Close-up of a 'Tea Series Chocolate' box being opened to reveal individually wrapped chocolates. (7) The woman holds two pieces of dark tea-infused chocolate, showing their square shape and texture before eating one. (8) A white bag of 'Tie-Guan-Yin Popcorn' is shown. (9) A hand holds two round, dark green tea popcorn kernels. (10) The woman holds the popcorn bag, eats a kernel, and touches her cheek in a gesture of delight. (11) Close-up of 'Gaufrette' wafer boxes in two different tea flavors. (12) The woman bites into a round wafer, showing the creamy tea filling inside. (13) A montage of other products: a box of 'Sorghum Liquor-Filled Chocolate', bags of sweet potato chips on a shelf, and packets of 'Peeled Chili Pepper Stock' soup base. (14) The camera pans over a shopping basket filled with many MUJI snack items. (15) The woman with pink hair appears again, holding the shopping basket and gesturing excitedly in front of the MUJI shelves.

(5) [Subtitle]: 微酸的鳳梨果乾黑巧克力超搭. (6) [Subtitle]: 亞熱帶台灣水果就是好吃. (7) [Subtitle]: 小包裝也很適合當伴手禮. (8) [Variety]: 茶系列巧克力. (9) [Subtitle]: 日本人非常喜歡台灣茶. (10) [Subtitle]: 無印的茶系列巧克力超受歡迎. (11) [Variety]: 還有茶葉紋路✨. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, energetic female narration begins immediately over an upbeat electronic pop track with a synthesized drum beat. (2) A 'ding' sound effect triggers as the first product name appears. The narrator's speech is fast and enthusiastic. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound occurs during a quick scene change to the kitchen setting. (4) Loud, crisp 'crunch' sound effects are inserted as the narrator bites into the chocolate and wafers, emphasizing texture. (5) A 'pop' bubble sound effect highlights variety text appearing on screen. The music remains consistent in tempo and brightness throughout the entire log. (6) The narration concludes with a final energetic sentence, maintaining high arousal and positive valence until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Recommendation List -> Social Proof -> CTA
